trust_limits: Same Lean 4.34.1 kernel implementation (lean and leanchecker of one toolchain); not Comparator, not an independent kernel.

Prebuilt Mathlib d13f23b oleans from the read-only cache are trusted as compiled artifacts for elaboration; leanchecker --fresh re-checks every declaration in the import closure of the replayed modules, Mathlib included, in a fresh kernel environment.

decide +kernel proofs are kernel reductions of Bool-valued checkers over Nat / Fin V / List with GMP-accelerated Nat literals (part of the trusted kernel); no native code evaluation, no Lean.ofReduceBool.

The raw-certificate-to-Lean-object equality (blocks and every POINT x section) is the external stdlib audit audit_binding.py, not a Lean theorem; the Lean literal is the raw POINT 0 section, regenerated byte-identically from the raw file.

The meaning of the roots rests on the reviewer reading RdsqsKernel/Target.lean (IsSQS, derivedBlocks, IsDerivedParallelClass, IsDerivedResolution, IsRDSQS, Target, TargetAll, TargetCounts) and the Mathlib/core definitions listed in manifest.json definitions.

def Rdsqs.IsSQS.{u} : {V : Type u} → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} B => (∀ X ∈ B, X.card = 4) ∧ ∀ (T : Finset V), T.card = 3 → ∃! X, X ∈ B ∧ T ⊆ X
def Rdsqs.derivedBlocks.{u} : {V : Type u} → [DecidableEq V] → Finset (Finset V) → V → Finset (Finset V) :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] B x => Finset.image (fun X => X.erase x) ({X ∈ B | x ∈ X})
def Rdsqs.IsDerivedParallelClass.{u} : {V : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq V] → Finset (Finset V) → V → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] B x P => P ⊆ Rdsqs.derivedBlocks B x ∧ ∀ (y : V), y ≠ x → ∃! T, T ∈ P ∧ y ∈ T
def Rdsqs.IsDerivedResolution.{u} : {V : Type u} →
  [DecidableEq V] → Finset (Finset V) → V → Finset (Finset (Finset V)) → Prop :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] B x R =>
  (∀ P ∈ R, Rdsqs.IsDerivedParallelClass B x P) ∧ ∀ T ∈ Rdsqs.derivedBlocks B x, ∃! P, P ∈ R ∧ T ∈ P
def Rdsqs.IsRDSQS.{u} : {V : Type u} → [DecidableEq V] → Finset (Finset V) → Prop :=
fun {V} [DecidableEq V] B => Rdsqs.IsSQS B ∧ ∀ (x : V), ∃ R, Rdsqs.IsDerivedResolution B x R
def Rdsqs.Target : ℕ → Prop :=
fun v => ∃ B, Rdsqs.IsRDSQS B
def Rdsqs.TargetAll.{u} : ℕ → Prop :=
fun v => ∀ (V : Type u) [inst : Fintype V] [inst_1 : DecidableEq V], Fintype.card V = v → ∃ B, Rdsqs.IsRDSQS B
def Rdsqs.TargetCounts : ℕ → Prop :=
fun v =>
  ∃ B,
    Rdsqs.IsSQS B ∧
      B.card = v * (v - 1) * (v - 2) / 24 ∧
        ∀ (x : Fin v),
          (∀ T ∈ Rdsqs.derivedBlocks B x, T.card = 3 ∧ x ∉ T) ∧
            (Rdsqs.derivedBlocks B x).card = (v - 1) * (v - 2) / 6 ∧
              ∃ R, Rdsqs.IsDerivedResolution B x R ∧ R.card = (v - 2) / 2 ∧ ∀ P ∈ R, P.card = (v - 1) / 3
def Rdsqs.Generic.relabel.{u_1, u_2} : {V : Type u_1} → {W : Type u_2} → V ≃ W → Finset V → Finset W :=
fun {V} {W} e X => Finset.map e.toEmbedding X
@[irreducible] def Rdsqs.Generic.blocksOf.{u_1} : {G : Type u_1} →
  [AddCommGroup G] → [Fintype G] → [DecidableEq G] → Finset (Finset G) → Finset (Finset G) :=
fun {G} [AddCommGroup G] [Fintype G] [DecidableEq G] S =>
  Finset.univ.biUnion fun a => Finset.image (Rdsqs.Generic.relabel (Equiv.addRight a)) (Finset.image (insert 0) S)
def Rdsqs.Kernel.pt : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → ℕ → Fin v :=
fun v [NeZero v] n => ⟨n % v, ⋯⟩
def Rdsqs.Kernel.tri : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → Rdsqs.Kernel.RawTriple → Finset (Fin v) :=
fun v [NeZero v] e => {Rdsqs.Kernel.pt v e.1, Rdsqs.Kernel.pt v e.2.1, Rdsqs.Kernel.pt v e.2.2}
@[irreducible] def Rdsqs.Kernel.seedTriples : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List Rdsqs.Kernel.RawTriple) → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) :=
fun v [NeZero v] d => (List.map (Rdsqs.Kernel.tri v) d.flatten).toFinset
@[irreducible] def Rdsqs.Kernel.seedClasses : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List Rdsqs.Kernel.RawTriple) → Finset (Finset (Finset (Fin v))) :=
fun v [NeZero v] d => (List.map (fun c => (List.map (Rdsqs.Kernel.tri v) c).toFinset) d).toFinset
def Rdsqs.Kernel.blocks : (v : ℕ) → [NeZero v] → List (List Rdsqs.Kernel.RawTriple) → Finset (Finset (Fin v)) :=
fun v [NeZero v] d => Rdsqs.Generic.blocksOf (Rdsqs.Kernel.seedTriples v d)
@[irreducible] def Rdsqs.Kernel.resAt : (v : ℕ) →
  [NeZero v] → List (List Rdsqs.Kernel.RawTriple) → ℕ → Fin v → Finset (Finset (Finset (Fin v))) :=
fun v [NeZero v] d m x =>
